title: Favorite cornet players, Manuel Perez, and his aunt's dances
summary: He names Manuel Perez, Buddy Petit, Lee Collins, Albert Snaer and others as favorites, then recalls his aunt hiring bands for dances, Economy Hall, and the neighborhood grocery.
